hero.title:
Great ideas get stuck in notebooks.
I build them.
hero.subtitle: I design and build portfolios, websites and web apps for artists and creative businesses — so your idea becomes something people can see, click and share.

about.headline: Hi, I'm Orlando — Product builder
about.subtitle: For the past three years I've been building creative websites and web apps
about.intro: I work between two worlds: I handle the technical build, and I care about how things look and feel. So you don't have to explain your idea to a developer and then again to a designer. You explain it once, to me.
about.how_1_text: Clear plans, plain-language updates, no jargon.
about.how_2_text: Short cycles, so you see your idea take shape in days, not only at the end.
about.how_3_text: I'll bring ideas to the table, not just follow a brief.
about.stack: HTML • CSS • JavaScript • React • Next.js • WordPress • Git
about.what_i_build_title: What I can build for you:
about.what_i_build_1: Portfolios that feel like your work — for artists, photographers, performers and companies
about.what_i_build_2: Your idea, made digital — apps, interactive experiences, a home for your project
about.what_i_build_3: Website care — updates and fixes for the site you already have, no long contract
about.what_i_build_4: Small automations that connect the tools you already use
